defs.meaning: 在（信封上）写收件人姓名和邮址；对……讲话；致词；考虑处理（问题）；（高尔夫）就位击球（address 的现在分词）

examples.en: Despite my attempts to get him to call me by my Christian name, he insisted on addressing me as "Mr. Kennedy."
examples.zh: 尽管我试图让他直接叫我的名，可他还是坚持称呼我为“肯尼迪先生”。

examples.en: We finished addressing over three hundred envelopes.
examples.zh: 我们写了三百多个信件地址了。

examples.en: He said to the Mole, addressing him across Toad's head, "He's quite hopeless."
examples.zh: 他隔着托德的头对鼹鼠莫尔说：“他已经不可救药了。”
